checks.finding: For an original nonnegative radial monomial and reciprocal E^-p, the spatially integrated density has exponent D-1+2j+r-2n-p. Its derivatives through ell-1 vanish if D>2n+ell+p after discarding nonnegative numerator improvements. The proposed additional2max(H_upper-1,0) is conservative. This defines a joint high-D family, not an independent E^-p times delta product.

At fixed spatial momentum, each shell-mass derivative of E^-p contributes at most two extra inverse energy powers. Each upper-energy derivative costs at most one; using the existing2J_i bound is conservative. Keep the original multiplier fixed before shell differentiation; differentiating a massless endpoint answer does not supply this distribution.

The only new factors are products of individual compact energies. They do not change virtual Gaussian exponents or eta Mellin powers. Subtracting p_i from each compact radial degree retains a positive D slope for every finite label/proof. Existing transfer and collinear bounds still apply. A common domain is finite-label dependent, not uniform over an unbounded symbolic index box.

For E_epsilon=sqrt(r^2-i epsilon), |E_epsilon|^2=sqrt(r^4+epsilon^2)>=r^2. Thus |E_epsilon|^-p<=r^-p, and finite derivatives are controlled by the strengthened origin bounds. The fixed-T Fermi pole strip and exponential tail remain necessary; remove line regulators first, then T, then the certified eta endpoint and meromorphic D continuation.

The divergence of v=U/(2E) and derivative of E^-p give -(p+1)M[n,p+2]/2; differentiating the upper theta gives -S[n,p+1]/2. Together with -nM[n+1,p], the exact identity follows from n*binom(a,n)=(a-n+1)*binom(a,n-1). The upper surface cannot be omitted.

The isolated API already accepts signed energy exponents with d>0, mu>0, mass0 and1<=n<=32, cancels the complete binomial/beta ratio before dimension specialization, and rejects a genuine pole. It returns occupied normalization; raw C_n requires the existing (-1)^n conversion. This API alone grants no graph-origin or lower-contact prescription.
